FN-ZLC9RRW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 255
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 255 as introduced would allow any sheriff to contract for service of process which
could increase obligations of the sheriffs by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the terms
of such contract. The increase in obligations could be off set, in whole or in part, by the increase
in receipts to the several sheriffs, circuit clerks, and district attorneys by $44, $3 and $3,
respectively for each $50 service of process fee collected, as authorized by this bill.
Page 1

Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2024
House Bill 255 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security would
allow any sheriff to contract for service of process which could increase obligations of the
sheriffs by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the terms of such contract. The increase in
obligations could be off set, in whole or in part, by the increase in receipts to the several sheriffs,
circuit clerks, and district attorneys by $42, $5 and $3, respectively for each $50 service of
process fee collected, as authorized by this bill.
